description: Demo xMB template: broadcast a live HLS stream over MBMS. One Application session in Pull mode -- the BM-SC fetches the HLS manifest + segments directly from RTVE's CDN and FLUTE-delivers them. Load, then Activate the session in the portal's xMB tab. (A local hls-http-proxy.js exists in this directory as a fallback: some libcurl builds -- specifically ones using GnuTLS as the TLS backend -- fail this CDN's TLS1.3/HTTP2 handshake with 'received handshake message out of context'; if that recurs, point applicationEntryPointURL below at the proxy instead and start it with `node hls-http-proxy.js`.)
